title: ""

assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? What are you currently unable to do
with `dstft`, or what's awkward/inefficient about the current API?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see added or changed. If this touches `src/dstft/`'s
numerical behavior (a new formula, a new mode, a change to an existing
default), please say so explicitly — those changes get extra scrutiny, see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions, workarounds, or existing tools you've considered
and why they don't fully address the problem.

## Additional context

Anything else that's relevant (e.g. a paper reference, a related issue, a
minimal code sketch of the proposed API).
